metadata.case_name: WONG TAK HING v. TAI SANG INDUSTRIAL CO LTD

injuries.description: he has become a permanent quadriplegic.
source: he has become a permanent quadriplegic.
injuries.icd_description: Injury of cervical spinal cord, unspecified

injuries.description: a severe contracture of his right hip joint;
source: a severe contracture of his right hip joint;
injuries.icd_description: Injury of unspecified muscle, fascia, tendon or bursa at hip or thigh level

injuries.description: Having severe deformity of his fingers due to quadriplegia he is unable to grasp with his hands.
source: Having severe deformity of his fingers due to quadriplegia he is unable to grasp with his hands.
injuries.icd_description: Injuries to the wrist or hand

manifestations.description: incontinence of the bladder and of the bowels
very severe spasms of his two lower limbs
recurrent and persistent urinary tract infection

has to be looked after by a trained medical officer; his daily activities such as getting up from bed, brushing his teeth, washing his face, putting on his clothes, underwear, socks, shoes and sitting on a wheelchair all have to be undertaken for him by the nursing staff
Being a heavy patient, he is not easy to dress and move around
pain in the ribs and a lot of pain in his hip-bone and right knee
has to be turned over in bed three or four times a night, a ministration which is unsuccessful in obviating a lot of bed-sores
unable to grasp with his hands
the only task which he can perform for himself is to feed himself with the aid of a specially devised splint attached to his right arm and a spoon
He can propel his wheelchair only to a distance of about ten feet and that achievement takes a long time

his life expectation is assessed at five years to a maximum of ten years provided that he is under specialised trained nursing treatment for 24 hours a day in hospital. If he were to return home his life expectation is assessed at one year or less

treatments_future: specialised trained nursing treatment 24 hours a day in hospital
